newsitem.title: USA: Alltrista to buy U.S. plastics company.
newsitem.headline: Alltrista to buy U.S. plastics company.

text.p: Alltrista Corp on Thursday said it signed a letter of intent to buy Viking Industries, an Arkansas-based producer of large thermoformed plastic products sold to the manufactured housing and recreational vehicle industries.
Terms of the transaction, expected to be completed during the second quarter of 1997, were not disclosed.
Viking employs about 180 people at manufacturing plants in El Dorado, Arkansas, and South Whitley, Indiana. It had 1996 sales of $15 million.
Viking represents Alltrista's fourth acquisition in the last three years and its first in plastics. Alltrista makes and markets consumer products and industrial components.
